paper.title_en: Photon Gas Thermodynamics with $κ$-generalized statistics at Planck-Scale
paper.abstract_en: Kaniadakis, or $κ$-generalized, statistical mechanics provides a flexible framework for describing complex systems in the relativistic regime and predicts a richer phenomenology compared to its standard Maxwell-Boltzmann counterpart. In the present work, we extend the investigation of photon gas thermodynamics at the Planck scale within doubly special relativity to the framework of $κ$-generalized statistical mechanics. By adopting the $κ$-generalized statistical approach, we derive the principal thermodynamic quantities of a photon gas at the Planck scale, including the internal energy $U$, Helmholtz free energy $F$, pressure $P$, entropy $S$, and heat capacity $C_{\rm V}$. We find that these $κ$-deformed thermodynamic quantities exhibit nontrivial dependence on the deformation parameter $κ$. We then numerically evaluate these quantities as functions of temperature $T$, and reveal that, as $T$ approaches the Planck scale, the $κ$-deformed thermodynamic quantities are significantly suppressed relative to those in special relativity, while in the low-temperature regime they are enhanced and exceed their counterparts in special relativity, as a consequence of the $κ$-generalized statistics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究普朗克尺度下光子气的κ广义统计力学热力学，与黑洞热力学和广义相对论基础相关，具有理论深度和原创性。
decision.title_zh: κ-广义统计在普朗克尺度下的光子气热力学
decision.abstract_zh: Kaniadakis或κ广义统计力学为描述相对论性系统中的复杂系统提供了一个灵活的框架，并预测了比其标准麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼对应物更丰富的现象学。在本工作中，我们将双狭义相对论中普朗克尺度下光子气热力学的研究扩展到κ广义统计力学的框架。通过采用κ广义统计方法，我们推导了普朗克尺度下光子气的主要热力学量，包括内能U、亥姆霍兹自由能F、压强P、熵S和热容C_V。我们发现，这些κ变形热力学量表现出对变形参数κ的非平凡依赖性。然后，我们以温度T的函数形式对这些量进行数值评估，并揭示出，当T接近普朗克尺度时，κ变形热力学量相对狭义相对论中的量显著受到抑制，而在低温区域，它们增强并超过其在狭义相对论中的对应值，这是κ广义统计的结果。
